card.summary: 広告最小で最大333GBを登録不要で。会員になれば最大111日保存・送信履歴・受取フォルダまで、ぜんぶ無料。保管時暗号化とウイルスチェックは登録不要で標準装備。

free_tier.stated: 広告最小で最大333GBを登録不要で。会員になれば最大111日保存・送信履歴・受取フォルダまで、ぜんぶ無料。保管時暗号化とウイルスチェックは登録不要で標準装備。

retention.stated: Registered free members additionally get 111-day retention, send history and a receive folder. All free.

egress.terms: No bandwidth meter on the free tier; the paid product is a business plan, not storage or transfer.

record.tooling: Web form at /upload (drag-and-drop, folder upload, password, download-count limit, one-time download). No API, no rclone backend.
record.chaining: Account-less uploads so 333 GB x unlimited objects; retention 3-111 days chosen per drop means the chain is a re-upload cron rather than an accumulating archive.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 333 GB. Retention 3-111 days (free registration unlocks the 111-day end). Optional password, optional download-count cap, optional one-time download.
record.reliability_note: Newer entrant (the operator runs a comparison blog and scores itself #1, which is a caveat on the ranking but not on the numbers). Operator holds a Japanese PrivacyMark. Ad-supported rather than paid-tier-supported, so the free tier is the business model.
